response.original_title: Encuentro Coleman. Qué suerte que esta noche voy a verte
response.overview: A documentary that goes behind the scenes of La omisión de la familia Coleman, a Buenos Aires stage play that has been running for twenty-two seasons and still sells out after touring the world’s most important venues. Through gestures, words, laughter and whispers, it examines the mechanisms that keep a hit alive and the reasons audiences from different eras, generations and cultures keep choosing it, exploring the bonds woven both on and off the stage.
response.title: Encuentro Coleman. Qué suerte que esta noche voy a verte
